chunks: Al-Sakūnī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a man and a boy who joined together in killing a man and killed him, he said: Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: "If the boy has reached five hand spans, qiṣāṣ is carried out against him and for him; but if the boy has not reached five hand spans, then judgment is made for the diyyah."

key_terms.اقْتُصَّ لَهُ: Retaliatory punishment was also recognized in his favor
key_terms.اقْتُصَّ مِنْهُ: Retaliatory punishment was carried out against him
key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: Blood money paid as legal compensation for homicide
key_terms.خَمْسَةَ أَشْبَارٍ: A physical measure used here as the legal threshold for the boy

ai.seo_question: When is qiṣāṣ applied to a boy involved in killing according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a boy who participates with an adult in killing someone. It distinguishes between a boy who has reached a specified physical measure and one who has not, assigning qiṣāṣ in the first case and diyyah in the second.
